title: Login panel
responsibility: Shows sign-in availability, a Google sign-in button or the pending email-confirmation step.

inputs.name: LoginPanel.reason
inputs.default: Sign in with Google to open the projects you own and the ones you were invited to.
inputs.description: Optional introductory paragraph, rendered as plain text under the 'Sign in to Harness' heading; the default applies only when the value is undefined, so an empty string renders an empty paragraph. It matters only in that view, which appears when a session status is loaded, sign-in is configured and no email proof is pending.
examples: Sign in with Google to open the projects you own and the ones you were invited to.
Sign in with Google to open the reports your team shared with you.
Sign in with the Google account that received your project invitation.

inputs.name: LoginPanel.compact
inputs.description: Places the sign-in controls in the surrounding layout by omitting the card styling, introductory heading and paragraph.

outputs.name: LoginPanel
outputs.description: Renders, in this precedence order, a 'Checking sign-in…' message (or the session error in its place) while no session status exists; a 'Sign-in is not configured' heading with guidance when status is not configured; the EmailProofPanel while an email proof is pending; and otherwise the 'Sign in to Harness' view. Inside that view a Google button is loaded into the holder only when status is configured, has no actor and a clientId, and no email proof is pending; each load requests a fresh challenge, ignores completions made stale by a re-run or unmount, shows challenge, button and session errors as alerts, and keeps a challenge or button failure set until the component is destroyed.
